fields.Name: T096 - Conversation Selection Mode Bulk Bar
fields.Description: Exercises the isSelectionMode UI and bulk-delete action bar — a distinct multi-select branch of ConversationListComponent separate from single-item delete.
fields.ExpectedOutcomes:
{
  "goalCompleted": true,
  "minConfidence": 0.7,
  "maxSteps": 35,
  "judgeValidationCriteria": [
    "Ctrl/Cmd-clicking two conversation rows selects both (accent tint) without opening them, and the list header shows a selection bar reading '2 selected' with Clear selection (X), Pin, Move to folder, Share and Delete icon buttons",
    "Right-clicking a selected row opens a single context menu headed '2 selected' that offers Pin, Unpin, Move to folder, 'Share 2 conversations' and 'Delete 2'",
    "Escape closes the context menu and Clear selection (X) ends the selection — the tint is gone and the 'Search conversations...' box is back",
    "No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages"
  ]
}
